verdict.rationale: Fivetran's own documented capability lands synced data in open table formats in your own data lake or warehouse, so the data already sits in customer-controlled storage in open formats. The pack documents nothing about exiting the platform itself, such as exporting connector configurations or account metadata, or any off-boarding path. The REST API is only a developer building block and is not credited. Missing for 10: documented export of Fivetran-held configuration/metadata, explicit exit or portability guidance, naming of the specific open formats, independent corroboration of leaving cleanly.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Automatically sync query‑ready, fully‑managed data to your data lake in open table formats.
Fivetran provides pre-built data connectors that automatically sync data from your applications, databases, event streams, and files to your data warehouse or data lake.
